basic_info.description: Rarely available Pacific Heights TWO UNIT BUILDING in a super location. The VACANT lower full floor flat features a living room with a fireplace , a dining room with a fireplace, a fully equipped updated kitchen and an adjacent laundry room, two bedrooms and one and one-half bathrooms. The TENANT OCCUPIED upper full floor flat features a living room with a fireplace, a dining room with a fireplace, a fully equipped updated kitchen and a laundry room, two bedrooms and one and one-half bathrooms. The upper flat opens to the rear deck and garden.
